equation: log employment = occupation FE + year FE + beta Z_occ Post2023 + theta Z_occ linear trend
weights: 2019-2021 occupation total employment, fixed across outcomes
standardisation: once within candidate sample, weighted mean and population SD, before dropping zero outcome rows
inference: occupation clustered CR1 G/(G-1), Student t G-1; manuscript 2000 score permutations and leave-one-occupation-out
high_low: fixed 2025 score employment-weighted quintiles, midrank allocation
data: corrected employed-person filter and verified mapping retained; no old data error reintroduced
annual_dynamic_DID: not used as replacement for manuscript equation
